# Lenslide — Design & Research Notes

- **Source Template**: ColorLib Carousel 14 (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/carousel-14/`)
- **Preview URL**: `https://preview.colorlib.com/theme/bootstrap/carousel-14/`
- **Color Palette**:
  - Primary Accent: `#007bff` (Bootstrap blue for active indicators and buttons)
  - Surface Light: `#f8f9fa` (card and quote background)
  - Text: `#212529` (headings/body), `#b3b3b3` (subtext/quotes)
- **Typography**: Roboto sans-serif font family.
- **Layout Structure**:
  - Split 40% image / 60% text layout for each testimonial slide.
  - Interactive navigation (arrows + pagination dots).
  - Clean minimalist page layout centering on the high-impact carousel showcase.
